comment: Raw form-control selectors in a feature stylesheet, per file. The ratchet fails on a new selector and on a recorded selector that has gone, so the list can only shrink. Every business stylesheet is listed, including the ones that are clean: a stylesheet that is absent from this file is a stylesheet the ratchet does not watch, which is how the eleven unwatched ones came to hold 58 selectors nobody could see. Regenerate the entries after a migration.
